India's Supreme Court Rejects CBI Inquiry into Bharat Tivari Encounter

The Indian Supreme Court has rejected a petition seeking a Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) inquiry into the encounter of Bharat Tivari, a former police officer. The court allowed Tivari to appeal to the High Court instead. This decision has sparked debate over the handling of the case and the role of the CBI.
